questions.stem: I ______ my homework already. I ______ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 第一空后面有already（已经），是现在完成时的标志词，表示动作已经完成，用have finished；第二空后面有an hour ago（一小时前），是一般过去时的标志，表示过去某个具体时间发生的动作，用finished。句意：我已经完成作业了。我一小时前做完的。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The boy ______ is wearing a red jacket is my brother.
questions.explanation: 先行词是the boy（指人），定语从句中缺少主语，因此用关系代词who。which用于指物；whom用于指人但在从句中作宾语；whose表示'...的'，在从句中作定语。句意：那个穿着红色夹克的男孩是我哥哥。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The new bridge ______ by the workers last year.
questions.explanation: 主语the new bridge（新桥）与动词build（建造）之间是被动关系，需要用被动语态be+done；时间状语last year（去年）表示过去，因此用一般过去时的被动语态was built。is built是一般现在时被动；built是主动语态过去式；has built是现在完成时主动语态。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem:
—______ you ever ______ to the Great Wall?
—Yes, I ______ there with my parents last summer.
questions.explanation: 第一空有ever（曾经），是现在完成时标志，且人已经回来，用have been to（去过某地）；第二空last summer（去年夏天）是过去时间状语，用一般过去时went。have gone to表示去了某地（人未回），不符合答句语境；did和do开头的一般疑问句无法与ever搭配表示经历。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: Please ______ the lights before leaving the classroom.
questions.explanation: turn off表示'关闭（电器、水源等）'，符合句意'离开教室前请关灯'。turn on是打开；turn up是调大（音量）；turn down是调小（音量）或拒绝。根据before leaving（离开前）的语境，应该是关灯。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: -ing结尾的形容词exciting（令人兴奋的）通常修饰事物，-ed结尾的形容词excited（感到兴奋的）通常修饰人。第一空修饰news（消息，事物），用exciting；第二空修饰everyone（每个人，人），用excited。句意：这个令人兴奋的消息让每个人都感到兴奋。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We should ______ our best to protect the environment.
questions.explanation: try one's best是固定搭配，意为'尽某人最大努力'。do one's best也有此意，但选项B是do，缺少one's；make one's best和take one's best都不是正确搭配。句意：我们应该尽最大努力保护环境。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.explanation: 根据上下文，活动目的是帮助学生理解保护环境的'重要性'。importance（重要性）符合语境。the importance of是固定搭配。result（结果）、reason（原因）、example（例子）代入后语义不通。

Last month, our school held an activity called "Green School, Green Life". The purpose was to help students understand the (8)______ of protecting our environment.

What surprised us most was that the amount of waste produced by our school dropped by 30% in just two weeks. This (11)______ us that small actions can make a big difference. The headmaster praised our efforts and said we were (12)______ role models for other schools.

questions.stem: According to the passage, how many hours of sleep do teenagers need at least?
questions.explanation: 细节理解题。根据文章第二段第二句'Teenagers need at least 8 hours of sleep every night.'（青少年每晚至少需要8小时睡眠）可知答案为C。做细节题要找准关键词teenagers和sleep，在原文中定位具体数字。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解
questions.group_passage:
Do you know how to keep your brain healthy? Many people think that doing math problems is the only way to exercise the brain. However, scientists have found that daily habits play a more important role.

First, getting enough sleep is crucial. During sleep, the brain removes waste chemicals (chemicals 化学物质) that build up during the day. Teenagers need at least 8 hours of sleep every night. Without enough rest, it becomes hard to concentrate (concentrate 集中注意力) on studies.

Second, physical exercise benefits the brain too. When you run or play ball games, your heart pumps more blood to the brain. This helps improve memory and learning ability. A study shows that students who exercise regularly often get better grades than those who don't.

Third, eating the right food matters. Fish, nuts and fruits contain nutrients (nutrients 营养) that are good for brain development. On the other hand, too much sugar and junk food can make you feel tired and slow down your thinking speed.

Finally, learning new skills keeps the brain active. Whether it's playing a musical instrument or speaking a new language, challenging your brain helps create new connections between brain cells.

In short, keeping your brain healthy is not as difficult as you might think. Start with these simple habits, and you will see the difference.

options: A. Only math problems can exercise the brain.
B. Students who exercise often may perform better in studies.
C. Junk food helps improve thinking speed.

questions.explanation: 推理判断题。根据第三段最后一句'A study shows that students who exercise regularly often get better grades than those who don't.'（研究表明经常锻炼的学生往往比不锻炼的学生成绩更好）可推断出经常锻炼的学生学业表现可能更好。A选项与第一段'许多人认为做数学题是唯一锻炼大脑的方式，然而科学家发现日常习惯更重要'相悖；C选项与第四段'太多糖和垃圾食品会让你感到疲劳并减慢思维速度'相悖；D选项文中未提及且与最后一段建议学习新技能相悖。

options: A. The Importance of Math Problems
B. How to Sleep Well Every Night
C. Ways to Keep Your Brain Healthy
D. Why Exercise is Good for You

(19)______ We could practice speaking with classmates and even foreign teachers there. Little by little, I found myself looking forward to English classes.
